draft_en.subject: Switches to sell alongside your compatible optics
draft_en.body:
Hi Rick,

I wrote on 21 October under "24 Port PoE Managed Switch"; this is a different angle, so a fresh note rather than a reply.

Since ND ships compatible optics into 50+ OEM platforms, a neutral switch line that takes third-party optics without coding games may fit next to it: Marvell-based L2+ switches with 4 x 10G SFP+ uplinks for the campus side, and Centec-based L3 ToR (STH-2C24XF-HSI, 24 x 10G SFP+ + 2 x 100G, USD 1,500 EXW Shenzhen, snapshot 2026-10-27, valid 15 days) for the data-center side. Open SFP policy on all of them.

Have you considered adding a switch line to the optics business, or do you prefer to stay optics-only?

Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
